source.title: Collection rates for Council Tax and non-domestic rates in England, 2025 to 2026
source.edition: 2025 to 2026 release from the QRC4 returns, first published 24 June 2026 and revised 31 July 2026 to add Kensington & Chelsea and correct some arrears figures
tables: Table 9a: Council tax - total receipts and arrears information, England, 2025-26
source.precision: Amounts in whole thousands of pounds as displayed; the in-year collection rate is a percentage to 2 decimal places as displayed; [x] marks a figure not available or suppressed

notes.text: Figures for 2025-26 have been revised to include data for Kensington & Chelsea who were unable to submit data in time for the original June publication. This addition changes all figures for England and London aggregates. Small arrears revisions were also made for Bradford (in Table 9b) and Stoke-on-Trent (in Table 9a). The affected cells are named for these changes.
